title: Claude's early progress in drug development
summary: Anthropic reports early results with six partners: a CAR T-cell receptor design about 70% shorter that enabled immune cells to produce about 10 times more receptors; about 35,000 antibody designs in one month, yielding 20 candidates; and a document review that found all 11 human-identified issues plus seven more in 89% less time. The work is mostly preclinical and reported by Anthropic.

evidence.tested: Partner lab tests and a document review reported by Anthropic: a CAR T receptor design was tested in immune cells, antibody designs were screened for IgE binding, and a review of 1,061 pages was compared with 11 human-identified issues.
evidence.unknown: The work is mostly preclinical with no human tests; partner reports give limited methodological detail, and the page does not say whether the seven extra flags were confirmed.
evidence.ai_role: Claude proposed molecular and receptor designs, generated about 35,000 antibody designs, reviewed manufacturing documents, and drafted regulatory documents.
